A multi-layer substrate 190, formed in accordance with a second embodiment of the present invention and adapted to be used to form a vehicle trim panellradiator element integral unit, is illustrated in Fig. 7, where like reference numerals indicate like elements. The substrate 190 comprises a core layer 22 and first and second outer layers 240 and 250. Only a single outer 240 or 250 is provided on each side of the core layer 22. The first and second outer layers 240 and 250 are preferably of a greater thickness than any one of outer layers 24-27 of the Fig: 3 embodiment so as to give the substrate 190 and resulting vehicle trim panelradiator element integral unit sufficient strength. For example, each outer 240 and 250 may comprise six layers such as first, third, fourth and sixth layers 230, 232, 233 and 235 formed from polyethylene and having the same density and thickness as each polyethylene in the Fig: 4A embodiment and further comprise second and fifth glass veil or carbon fiber mat layers 231 and 234, which are of the same density and thickness as the glass veil or carbon fiber mat in the Fig. 4A embodiment. ayer layer layer layer

The substrate 19 or 190 may also be formed of a size sufficient to allow it to be molded into a headliner 90, see Fig. 8, or other vehicle component; such as a trunk liner (not shown).
